sources.snippet: 🔥 Contrastive Language Models (CLMs) are a new class of System One model trained with a contrastive learning objective that connects states and actions. This repo serves CLM-8B behind a TypeSafe-compatible API.

sources.title: Contrastive Learning Guide | AI Understanding
sources.snippet: Overview It matters because it lets AI learn powerful representations from mostly unlabeled data, powering image search, recommendations, and multimodal models. Contrastive Learning is a technical building block that affects model quality, infrastructure cost, latency, and reliability at scale.
